paper_title: The Cosmological Evolution of Light Dark Photon Dark Matter
notes: Paper derives theoretical constraints on dark photon dark matter from CMB, dark ages, and other cosmological observations (coupling: kinetic mixing χ). However, these are theoretical limits derived from cosmological data, not direct measurements or experimental exclusions of dark photons. Figure 3 shows multiple overlapping constraint curves from different physical processes (FIRAS, dark matter depletion, dark ages, μ/y-type distortions, He reionization). Paper explicitly states it provides an ancillary data file outlining the strongest constraint for each dark photon mass - this is the authoritative source. Unable to reliably extract individual curve coordinates from the complex Figure 3 without access to that ancillary file or additional calibration points in the paper text. Visual inspection suggests constraints span m_A' ~ 10^-22 to 10^-2 eV and χ ~ 10^-14 to 10^-8, with tightest constraints at χ ~ 10^-10 in the m ~ 10^-14 to 10^-10 eV range.
